checklist_note: The 100% checklist opens only after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts toward it.

items: Finish the 5 chapters (60–80 hours). All 12 story trophies pop automatically.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation (Positive Mental Attitude) — the one trophy you can miss.
Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study new animals with the binoculars as you meet them.
Do optional missions as they appear — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret all start during the story.
Keep 10 of your 15 manual save slots for chapter starts and ends; rotate the other 5 for cleanup.
stages.name: Story first
stages.summary: Play through the 5 chapters and enjoy the story. Do the side quests as they appear, scan vehicles and study animals as you go, and keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — there is no mission replay.

items: Any 100 optional missions (there are 200–300+ in total).
Any 70 of 80 challenges (50 unlocks One Last Thing on the way).
Scan 200 of 277 base vehicles; study 100 of 255 animals.
Complete 300 stunts (250 unlocks Cunning Stunts on the way).
All robberies, all shooting ranges, all drone races, all of Bret's quests.
Only 15 of 18 meditations are needed for 100%.
stages.name: 100% checklist
stages.summary: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. The checklist is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — and nothing toward it is missable.

items: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete and more).
Robbery cleanup: bank vaults, armored trucks, jewelry stores, gang operations.
Easter eggs and one-offs: the UFO, the Banshee showroom, the rooftop cocktail.
The platinum pops the moment the last trophy does.
stages.name: Strangers & cleanup
stages.summary: Finish the Strangers & Freaks strands and mop up whatever is left. Most of it pops while you work the checklist.

title: Road to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
warnings: ONE missable trophy: Positive Mental Attitude. Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (after Down to Earth) and keep a Chapter 1 save.
Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off for the whole run.
No mission replay and no New Game+. Manual saves are your only safety net.
The Irredeemable criminal profile is permanent — avoid it, or cops shoot on sight far more often.
